'''Domino Green''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''The Jackrabbit''' in the '''Orishis''' system. Raised and educated under a corporate public-relations programme before being dismissed as a poor investment, she later established her own workshop using a family inheritance.<ref name="inara-domino">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/27/ Domino Green — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, services, and referral record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-domino">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Domino_Green Domino Green], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

Domino is an independent starting Engineer specialising in suit utility and handheld-weapon performance. She opens the referral branch leading to [[Kit Fowler]].

The Jackrabbit is a surface Engineer base on Orishis 4, approximately 987 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-jackrabbit">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/237312/ The Jackrabbit — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| '''Common knowledge.''' Domino does not require a referral from another Engineer.
|-
| Unlock
| Travel at least '''100 light-years in shuttles'''.
|}

The required distance is cumulative and must be travelled using shuttle services; distance flown in the Commander's own ship does not substitute for it. Route planning and the ordered unlock process belong to [[Unlocking Domino Green]].<ref name="inara-domino" />

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-domino" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Domino installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. Her services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Enhanced Tracking
| Suit
| Increases the range and speed of the suit's basic scan function.
|-
| Extra Backpack Capacity
| Suit
| Increases the capacity of the suit's Data, Component, and Item storage.
|-
| Reduced Tool Battery Consumption
| Suit
| Reduces the energy consumed by applicable suit-tool functions.
|-
| Greater Range
| Handheld weapon
| Increases effective weapon range; recipes vary by manufacturer.
|-
| Stability
| Handheld weapon
| Reduces weapon recoil.
|}

These five modification types are available once Domino is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-domino" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Referral to Kit Fowler ==

After unlocking Domino, provide her with '''5 doses of Push''' to discover [[Kit Fowler]]. This referral item is separate from the shuttle travel required to unlock Domino herself.<ref name="inara-domino" /><ref name="inara-kit">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/29/ Kit Fowler — Engineer], INARA; current discovery prerequisite. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

<pre>
Domino Green
└── Kit Fowler
</pre>

Kit's own unlock conditions belong on [[Kit Fowler]] and in [[Unlocking Kit Fowler]].
